name: landing-hnd-yokohama
description: Couple lands at HND 09:15 on day 1 (2026-12-12), sleeps Yokohama Bashamichi days 1-2. Two Tokyo-based units (sg=Shinagawa, od=Odaiba). Both are >40 min from the Yokohama hotel, so they are excluded from the landing day. Day 2 (Yokohama, non-landing, normal start): cap=510, and since 26 Nov 2026 the day's load counts the real rides (hotel→sg≈50, sg→od≈23, the ride home past its first half hour≈22, 5 a stop), so the two visits are 200 minutes each (2×200+105=505 ≤ 525; at 240 each the day would be ten hours of visits and trains, over the cap). Within day 2 the order is [sg,od]: hotel→sg≈50 min + sg→od≈23 min = 73 min < hotel→od≈52 min + od→sg≈23 min = 75 min, so sg starts before od. A Tokyo move-day was deliberately NOT added: presence.ts forces start=840 on a hotel-change day, leaving cap=min(510,450)=450 — only 1 unit fits (520>465), so a 3-day version with 4 units would yield placedMin=3, not 4.
